name: Nippon Signal Co., Ltd.
summary: Nippon Signal Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops technologies for railway signal systems in Japan. The company operates in two segments, Transportation Infrastructure Business and ICT Solution Business segments. It offers railway signal safety systems, road traffic safety systems, station service automation systems, security solutions, parking lot system, robotics, platform safety systems, ground penetrating radars, and 3D laser ranging image sensors and MEMS scanners.
